svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT Y detailed field guide
svg.desc: Agent Y prepares and runs one bounded CLI task, creates review evidence, and supports recovery without merging or accepting it. This image also lists the exact folder, example prompt, CLI surfaces, five or six process steps, and role boundary.
svg.text: Bounded CLI work and pull-request handoff
Prepare one assigned task for an installed CLI.
Return branch or PR evidence for review; do not merge.
Agent Y uses host permissions and a selected installed CLI.
A PR handoff grants no merge authority or canonical task acceptance.
